messages.subject: Optimize function in parameter-by-parameter
parts:
Hello Phil,

The createItem allows us to select which parameters are fixed or to be estimated. But, can I tell it to optimize single parameter in turn?

Like, in one iteration, we optimize slope parameter first and others are fixed. Then optimize difficulty and others are fixed. Finally,  optimize the guessing parameter and others are fixed. I think it may stabilize the estimation.

Thank you~

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Optimize function in parameter-by-parameter
parts:
Unfortunately, this wouldn't help and would only serve to slow the estimation process down. The likelihood functions would still maximize to the same locations (if they didn't then something would be very wrong), so you don't gain anything by doing it piece-wise. Instability has more to do with the curvature of the observed-data log-likelihood than anything else, which really can only be fixed by including more empirical information (either by obtaining more samples, or including prior as a source of additional information).  

Phil
